debug_mode.description: Whether debug mode is enabled or disabled. Possible values are: 0 - (default) disabled; 1 - enabled.

gui_access.description: Frontend authentication method of the users in the group. Possible values: 0 - (default) use the system default authentication method; 1 - use internal authentication; 2 - use LDAP authentication; 3 - disable access to the frontend.

users_status.description: Whether the user group is enabled or disabled. Possible values are: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

rights.description: Permissions to assign to the group.

tag_filters.description: Tag based permissions to assign to the group.

users.description: Users to add to the user group. The user must have the userid property defined.

id.description: ID of the host group to add permission to.

permission.description: Access level to the host group. Possible values: 0 - access denied; 2 - read-only access; 3 - read-write access.

groupid.description: ID of the host group to add permission to.

userRef.description: User reference; the userid property must be defined.
